sources.title: Baseline Comparison | om-ai-lab/VLM-R1 | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: The baseline comparison capabilities in VLM-R1 enable thorough evaluation of GRPO models against traditional SFT approaches. By using consistent evaluation methodologies and metrics, the system provides a fair assessment of model performance, particularly highlighting the generalization advantages of GRPO-trained models on out-of-domain data.
